title: Valhallowed manifest
description: The settings of one install, written in TOML (G18). A later version only adds settings, or migrates a renamed key. The control plane enforces what this schema cannot express: no two worlds' port ranges overlap, and each duration lies within the range its x-seconds states.

schema.description: The schema version this file is written against.

world.description: The worlds this install runs: one table per world, keyed by its save name. With more than one world, every world sets its port.

port.description: The host TCP port the web map is published on.

backups.description: Each world's backups: copies of its newest complete save, taken while the world runs, after every clean stop, and before any action replaces its save.

path.description: The host folder backups live in, each world in a folder of its own. Relative to the install folder unless it starts with /, and without a colon, which Docker's volume syntax reserves. A folder on another disk keeps backups apart from the worlds they protect. vhd apply makes the folder, which then belongs to root, and each world's folder, which belongs to the game runtime's user, so removing them takes root. A world's folder stays when the world is removed or the path changes, and a world added again under the same save name finds its backups there.

every.description: How often, at most, a world backs up a new save: minutes, hours or days, such as 30m or 1h, from 5m to 1d.

keep.description: How many of its newest backups a world keeps, besides its daily ones. At most 100: a world's runtime reports every backup it keeps by name.

keep_daily.description: How many daily backups a world keeps: the newest backup of each of that many days, in UTC. 0 keeps none. At most 100: a world's runtime reports every backup it keeps by name.

updates.description: The update policy: when each world updates the dedicated server.

policy.description: when-empty: a world that finds Steam's public game build other than its own restarts to update once no players are online. at-start: it still checks, and updates only when it next starts.

every.description: How often each world checks Steam's public game build: minutes, hours or days, such as 15m, from 5m to 1d.

duration.description: A length of time: a whole number of minutes, hours or days, such as 15m, 1h or 1d.

save_name.description: A world's save name: the save the game loads, or creates when none has that name. VHD accepts 1 to 64 letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores, starting and ending with a letter or digit. That is stricter than the game, and widens only on evidence.

port.description: The first of the world's three UDP ports, its port through port+2. Defaults to 2456 when the install runs one world.
